title: Preemptive restart setting selection is hidden.  Please make it visible.
body:
It seems that if preemptive restart setting is checked, it is going to attempt a restart even if the "Restart Sensor" is unchecked.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5/permalink/4657078354365623/

This is not intuitive.  Therefore, there are people who look at their settings and see no restart and don't bother tapping on Preemptive restart.
Later, they wonder why their G6 sensor always stops on day 9.

What makes this more difficult to notice is that the preemptive restart selection does not show just looking at "G5/G6 Debug Settings" page.  One has to tap on "Preemptive restarts" to reveal the selection.

Is it possible to make the preemptive restart selection visible on the "G5/G6 Debug Settings" page?

comments.body: This is nice to have, not critical.  Closing
This feature is not needed any longer as preemptive restart will not be applied unless the transmitter is capable.
